summary: Soundness.lean: added the 4 axiom_sound bridge arms (allFuture_to_classic, classic_to_allFuture, allPast_to_classic, classic_to_allPast) as one-line .mp/.mpr applications of the P2 semantic bridge lemmas (Satisfies.sat_allFuture_iff_neg_someFuture_neg / sat_allPast_iff_neg_somePast_neg). Also repaired 6 pre-existing broken arms (left_mono_until_G, left_mono_since_H, right_mono_until, right_mono_since, connect_future, connect_past) and added the 2 missing swapTemporal_dual induction cases (allFuture, allPast) -- all were downstream breakage from Phase 2's primitive-constructor promotion (old code relied on the G ~ neg F neg defeq, now gone). `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.Soundness` is GREEN; lean_verify on axiom_sound shows only the 3 standard foundational axioms, no sorry. DenseSoundness.lean: confirmed axiom_sound_dense re-matches Base axioms directly and added the 4 mirrored arms delegating to axiom_sound via FrameClass.base_le, following the identical pattern of the other 24 Base-delegation arms. Scoped build of DenseSoundness.lean is BLOCKED: the file genuinely imports DenseMCS.lean -> MCS.lean (for Temporal.ThDerivableFc, used by the pre-existing soundness_thderivable_dense theorem), and MCS.lean is currently broken -- this is Phase 5's designated repair target (F1 root cause; break sites MCS.lean:170,213-216,230,269,276,374,474, matching the plan's cited 169/374/229/472). This dependency was not anticipated by the plan's 'Self-contained (F5)' framing for Phase 4. Did not touch MCS.lean (Phase 5 territory, single-phase focus).

blockers.description: Scoped `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.DenseSoundness` fails because the file transitively imports Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Metalogic/MCS.lean (via DenseMCS.lean, needed for Temporal.ThDerivableFc used by the pre-existing soundness_thderivable_dense theorem). MCS.lean currently fails with 'Application type mismatch' errors at lines 170, 213, 214, 216, 230, 269, 276, 374, 474 -- all instances of the F1 root-cause pattern (proofs assuming the old allFuture/allPast ~ neg-someFuture-neg / neg-somePast-neg defeq that Phase 2 removed by making allFuture/allPast primitive constructors). This is exactly Phase 5's designated repair scope (MCS bridge lemmas mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff + defeq-site repairs at the named break sites). The axiom_sound_dense edits made in this dispatch (4 new arms mirroring the established Base-delegation pattern) are believed correct but cannot be build-verified until Phase 5 lands.
blockers.exact_error_sample: error: Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Metalogic/MCS.lean:170:40: Application type mismatch: The argument h_not_g_psi has type (allFuture psi) not-in Omega but is expected to have type (neg (someFuture (neg psi))) not-in Omega in the application (mcs_mem_iff_neg_not_mem h_mcs).mpr h_not_g_psi

continuation_context.notes: Phase 4's own deliverable (4 axiom_sound arms + 4 mirrored axiom_sound_dense arms) is complete in content; only the DenseSoundness scoped-build gate is unmet due to the MCS.lean dependency chain. After Phase 5 repairs MCS.lean (mcs_allFuture_iff / mcs_allPast_iff + the named defeq-site repairs), re-run `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.DenseSoundness` -- no further changes to DenseSoundness.lean are expected to be needed. Reusable for Phase 5: the P2 bridge lemmas Satisfies.sat_allFuture_iff_neg_someFuture_neg / Satisfies.sat_allPast_iff_neg_somePast_neg are the semantic-level counterparts of the MCS-level mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff lemmas Phase 5 needs to add; the Soundness.lean repair pattern (using allFuture_iff/allPast_iff defeq directly instead of by_contra-style unfolding) may be a useful template for some MCS.lean sites too, though MCS operates over provability (Omega membership) rather than semantic Satisfies so the analogy is only structural.
